issue.title: [QA] AI Tutor Test Suite & Release Audit
issue.auditor: Senior QA Automation Engineer & Test Architect

verdict.summary: QA test suite is COMPLETE and passing with 100% objective coverage. Final production release verdict is NOT READY — BLOCKED due to missing Express backend gateway, CoursePlayer UI dock, microphone input, and audio TTS debouncing/cancellation implementation.

requirements_scorecard.title: Evaluation Dataset
requirements_scorecard.details: 10 in-scope questions mapped across 3 demo courses and 5 out-of-scope questions with refusal expectations.

requirements_scorecard.title: RAG Evaluation Tests
requirements_scorecard.details: Verified answer correctness, source attribution, course-level retrieval isolation, out-of-scope refusal, and missing context behavior.

requirements_scorecard.title: Backend API Tests
requirements_scorecard.details: FastAPI endpoints return 200, 400/422, and 404. Express auth returns 401. Express /api/v1/tutor gateway is missing and audited as BLOCKED.

requirements_scorecard.title: AI Tutor UI Automation
requirements_scorecard.details: CoursePlayer.tsx has no AI Tutor dock, chat drawer, or trigger button. Production UI feature not implemented.

requirements_scorecard.title: Microphone Permission-Denied Fallback
requirements_scorecard.details: No getUserMedia or speech recognition code in frontend. Contract specification test defined but production feature is blocked.

requirements_scorecard.title: Repeated Questions & Audio Interruption
requirements_scorecard.details: BLOCKED in production. No request debouncer, queue, or TTS audio playback element exists in the frontend. Passing Node test checks exercise simulated contract logic within the test file, not production frontend code.

requirements_scorecard.title: Response Latency Measurement
requirements_scorecard.details: Vector retrieval mean: 15.75ms. RAG pipeline mean: 5.41ms. API roundtrip mean: 30.95ms. Aggregate P95: 17.73ms. Test threshold (<350ms) passed. Live Ollama SLA (<5000ms) unverified in offline mock.

requirements_scorecard.title: Final Release QA Report
requirements_scorecard.details: Comprehensive Markdown and JSON reports produced.

production_blockers.description: Route /api/v1/tutor is not mounted in backend/src/app.js.
AI Tutor dock UI is missing from CoursePlayer.tsx.
Microphone permission and speech recognition handling is absent.
TTS playback, debouncing, and audio cancellation logic is absent.
